components.text: The [color=yellow]Coal Generator[color] is a basic power generator that uses coal as fuel. It provides a steady supply of energy for your machines and devices, making it an essential component for any off-earth colony.

[br] [br] How to use: [br] Place the coal generator in a suitable location and connect it to your power grid. Add coal to the fuel slot to start generating power. The generator will consume coal over time to produce energy. [br] [br] Stats: [br] - Power Output: 3 FE/t [br] - Fuel Type: Coal [br] - Fuel Consumption: 1 coal produces 4800 FE
